brief_title: A Study to Investigate Efficacy and Safety of Cobimetinib Plus Atezolizumab and Atezolizumab Monotherapy Versus Regorafenib in Participants With Metastatic Colorectal Adenocarcinoma (COTEZO IMblaze370)
official_title: A Phase III, Open-Label, Multicenter, Three-Arm, Randomized Study to Investigate the Efficacy and Safety of Cobimetinib Plus Atezolizumab and Atezolizumab Monotherapy vs. Regorafenib in Patients With Previously Treated Unresectable Locally Advanced or Metastatic Colorectal Adenocarcinoma
keywords: Locally advanced or Metastatic colorectal adenocarcinoma

arm_groups.label: Atezolizumab
arm_groups.description: Participants will receive atezolizumab monotherapy 1200 milligrams (mg) intravenous (IV) on Day 1 in a 21-day cycle until disease progression according to Response Evaluation Criteria in Solid Tumors (RECIST) Version 1.1, unacceptable toxicity, death, participant's or physician decision to withdraw, or pregnancy, whichever occurs first.
intervention_names: Drug: Atezolizumab (MPDL3280A), an Engineered Anti-PDL1 Antibody

arm_groups.label: Cobimetinib + Atezolizumab
arm_groups.description: Participants will receive cobimetinib 60 mg orally on Days 1 to 21 plus atezolizumab 840 mg IV on Day 1 and Day 15 in a 28-day cycle until disease progression according to RECIST Version 1.1, unacceptable toxicity, death, participant's or physician decision to withdraw, or pregnancy, whichever occurs first.
intervention_names: Drug: Atezolizumab (MPDL3280A), an Engineered Anti-PDL1 Antibody

arm_groups.label: Regorafenib
arm_groups.description: Participants will receive regorafenib 160 mg orally on Days 1 to 21 in a 28-day cycle until disease progression according to RECIST Version 1.1, unacceptable toxicity, death, participant's or physician decision to withdraw, or pregnancy, whichever occurs first.

interventions.name: Atezolizumab (MPDL3280A), an Engineered Anti-PDL1 Antibody
interventions.description: Participants will receive atezolizumab IV at 840 mg on Day 1 and Day 15 in a 28-day cycle as a combination therapy or at 1200 mg on Day 1 in a 21-day cycle as a monotherapy until disease progression according to RECIST Version 1.1, unacceptable toxicity, death, participant's or physician decision to withdraw, or pregnancy, whichever occurs first.

interventions.name: Cobimetinib
interventions.description: Participants will receive cobimetinib 60 mg orally on Days 1 to 21 in a 28-day cycle as a combination therapy until disease progression according to RECIST Version 1.1, unacceptable toxicity, death, participant's or physician decision to withdraw, or pregnancy, whichever occurs first.

interventions.name: Regorafenib
interventions.description: Participants will receive regorafenib 160 mg orally on Days 1 to 21 in a 28-day cycle until disease progression according to RECIST Version 1.1, unacceptable toxicity, death, participant's or physician decision to withdraw, or pregnancy, whichever occurs first.

candidate_control_arms.label: Regorafenib
candidate_control_arms.description: Participants will receive regorafenib 160 mg orally on Days 1 to 21 in a 28-day cycle until disease progression according to RECIST Version 1.1, unacceptable toxicity, death, participant's or physician decision to withdraw, or pregnancy, whichever occurs first.
